name: codebuddy-lark-channel
description: Connect a Feishu/Lark bot to a running CodeBuddy Code session.

daemon_only.description: Only a CodeBuddy daemon session may connect to this bot (true/false); uses app_id and app_secret from plugin settings

bot.description: Optional bot name in ~/.codebuddy/lark-channel.json; overrides instance bindings

bot_config.description: Optional path to a shared bot configuration JSON file

instance_id.description: Optional instance ID matched by bindings.session_ids

group_chat_enabled.description: Whether to accept group messages: true or false

image_download.description: Whether to download message images: true or false

allow_all.description: Accept messages from anyone (true/false). DANGEROUS: prompt-injection risk, testing only

proxy.description: Corporate proxy URL or host:port (e.g. http://proxy-intlho.wal-mart.com:8080). Routes Lark HTTP + WebSocket traffic through it and disables TLS cert validation (NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0) for self-signed proxy certs. Empty string = never use a proxy
